text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward her first target race of 
the Senior Year, the Victoria Mile—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu stoically continued to push 
herself to the limit.
choice_data_list: Just one more set to go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps as a fruit of that intense focus, 
Mejiro Ramonu's growth shows no signs of 
slowing down even in the Senior class. 
Could it be born from her insatiable 
mental drive—?
choice_data_list: (No, maybe it's the power of love)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ramone-san is incredible... Isn't she 
training harder than anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, she's already so strong... and she 
even declared war on President Rudolf, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, we ran together in the 
Hanshin JF. But... I bet we'll never run 
in the same race again, will we?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
...Mejiro Ramonu. Someone so endlessly 
distant, completely out of reach...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
...I'll just see the Victoria Mile 
through, and then... I won't let it bother 
me anymoreâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then came the day of the Victoria 
Mile.
choice_data_list:
You don't need to keep an eye outside 
today?
Is it okay not to look outside today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Of course I know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—There's a huge crowd. With all the hype 
drummed up for the showdown with Rudolf, 
attention is at an all-time high.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"However, this passion isn't aimed at me. 
They are testing to see how I will run in 
the Senior year."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu spoke calmly. Her words 
aligned perfectly with what I had just 
witnessed...
choice_data_list: Then I'll just have to remind you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Aren't we confident?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many of the runners in the Victoria Mile 
are Umamusume who made their mark on the 
Tiara route across different generations. 
If we can win among them――
choice_data_list:
Your value as a Classic contender will 
only rise even higher!

Your Classic Year will become even more 
valuable!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To 'see for yourself'...? I won't waste 
any more of your time."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My love is unmistakable, after all.
